title: Logo bloom
description: A short logo intro: the mark grows out of a seed, turning a quarter turn and pulling focus as it lands with motion blur, then the wordmark settles in under it. 2.5 s, silent, 16:9.

slots.name: logo
slots.note: The user's square logo from the library (transparent PNG is best), as an asset name; null draws an eight-petal mark in the ink colour.

slots.name: wordmark
slots.note: The brand name under the mark, at most 14 characters; empty for the mark alone.

slots.name: ink
slots.note: The drawn mark and the wordmark.

beats.say: The mark blooms out of a seed.
beats.visual: A tiny blurred seed grows into the logo while turning a quarter turn, with motion blur, and lands sharp.

beats.label: Wordmark
beats.visual: The brand name fades up 10 px under the mark and the lockup holds still.
